name: pl.infozwierz/zwierzeta
title: InfoZwierz.pl
description: How much does a pet cost in Poland: purchase, startup, monthly and vet costs per breed. Read-only.

tools.name: search_animals
tools.description: Search pets (breeds and species) listed on InfoZwierz.pl and get their costs in Poland in PLN: purchase price, startup kit, typical monthly cost and first-year total, with the card link. Filters (all optional, combine freely): query (breed or species name in Polish or English, Latin name), group, max_monthly_pln; sort by relevance or cost (e.g. cheapest_monthly for "cheapest dogs to keep"). Returns at most 10 animals per call and total_found; there is no paging, narrow the filters instead. Example calls: {"query":"beagle"} or {"group":"psy","sort":"cheapest_monthly","limit":5}. / Szukaj rasy albo gatunku: koszt zakupu, wyprawki, miesiąca i 1. roku z linkiem do karty.

query.description: Breed or species name, e.g. "beagle", "maine coon", "gekon lamparci", "axolotl". / Nazwa rasy lub gatunku.

group.description: Animal group id (see list_groups). Words like "dog", "pies", "cat", "reptiles" are accepted too. / Grupa.

max_monthly_pln.description: Only animals with typical monthly cost up to this amount in PLN.

sort.description: Order: relevance (name match, popular first), cheapest_monthly, most_expensive_monthly, cheapest_start, cheapest_purchase, cheapest_first_year.

tools.name: get_animal
tools.description: Full cost breakdown of one pet on InfoZwierz.pl by id (slug from search_animals), card URL or name: purchase price with source and date (or price abroad in PLN when no Polish breeder sells it), startup kit, monthly cost split into food, other supplies and electricity, vet costs per year and in the first year in the chosen city, first-year total, legal status, price read date and the card link. Missing amounts are "brak danych". Example call: {"id":"buldog-angielski","city":"warszawa"}. / Rozbicie kosztów jednego zwierzęcia z datą cen.

name.description: Breed or species name when the id is unknown; the best match is returned.

city.description: City for vet prices: slug from list_groups (e.g. "warszawa", "krakow") or name with or without Polish letters. Default "polska" = vet price lists from several Polish cities. / Miasto do cen leczenia.

tools.name: compare_animals
tools.description: Compare costs of two pets on InfoZwierz.pl (ids or names): purchase, startup, monthly and first-year total with vet costs in the chosen city, plus the difference. Required: `first` and `second`. Example call: {"first":"buldog-angielski","second":"maine-coon"}. / Porównanie kosztów dwóch zwierząt.

city.description: City for vet prices: slug from list_groups (e.g. "warszawa", "krakow") or name with or without Polish letters. Default "polska" = vet price lists from several Polish cities. / Miasto do cen leczenia.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: Animal groups on InfoZwierz.pl with the number of cards and of cards with prices, the id to pass as `group` to search_animals and the group page link, plus cities with vet price lists (slug for `city`). No arguments; example call: {}. / Lista grup zwierząt i miast z cenami leczenia.
